data.notes_tail: 3803's card grew 630->732px because bigger icons change the measured content extent, which is why the whole figure is rewritten rather than just the src. 2 of 17 uploads collided and came back as -r2-1.webp; use the response url verbatim, and simpatch then reports 'missing' for out/<served name> which is the check confused by the rename, not a bad patch. NOTE: this deliberately breaks the IWC pixel-identity rule - IWC steps/icons are still at 47% and that is a separate decision, do not restore.
